images.title: Partners in the wild
images.caption: Wolf Awareness Week
images.desc: Two gray wolves move through the sagebrush of Yellowstone National Park in Wyoming, home to some of North America's most closely watched wolf packs. Their thick coats help them withstand harsh winters, and their keen senses make them skilled hunters and communicators.
